page.overview:
What is Red Genesect?

Red Genesect is a shiny mythical Pokémon that appears only in Genesect and the Legend Awakened as the main antagonist. It was part of Team Plasma's "Project G".

Prior to the events of the anime and the sixteenth movie, the Red Genesect and its minions were created by Team Plasma in their secret laboratory. After the creation proved successful, they all used Techno Blast against Team Plasma, causing them to retreat. The Red Genesect then led them out of the burning lab and escaped by attempting to return to their homeland. Though it did not appear in the anime series in person, it was shown numerous times in flashbacks and mentioned several times by Team Plasma Grunts. The Red Genesect, alongside its allies, appeared in person in the sixteenth movie, Genesect & the Legend Awakened. They are first seen flying around a snowy climate looking for their home, as they thought it was there. As the Red Genesect went to the top of the mountain, it became trapped in a deadly avalanche, while its teammates were saved by Mewtwo. After Mewtwo told the Genesect Army about how much time had passed since they were alive, the Red Genesect escaped from the avalanche, and Mewtwo then tried to convince it to join her side. The Red Genesect refuses to listen to anyone's orders and calls Mewtwo a threat to the Genesect Army, which it then attacks, but Mewtwo gets out of the way. The Red Genesect then controlled its teammates to attack Mewtwo, who flew off. The Red Genesect and the Genesect Army then arrived at New York City, where they went to Pokémon Hills, which they mistook for their home, and wandered about as they pleased. After seeing the Douse Drive Genesect with Ash Ketchum and his friends, it mistook the Douse Drive Genesect as being attacked and then attacked Ash and the Shock Drive Genesect, thinking they were a threat. It then controlled the Douse Drive Genesect to attack Ash and his friends, but Douse Drive was saved by Mewtwo. After this, the entire Genesect Army retreated. During the night, it led its teammates to invade Pokémon Hills, forcing the Pokémon there to leave, then building their nest atop the power generator. A Feralitgatr living in the Pokémon Hills tried to stop them, but ended up in a fight with the Shock Drive Genesect and Red Genesect, who managed to defeat the Feralitgatr with its Blaze Kick. Mewtwo then arrives and saves the Feraligatr just in time, and then tries to convince the Red Genesect to live peacefully. The Red Genesect refused to listen to such "orders," and the two fought throughout New Tork City before controlling the Genesect Army, which fought Ash and his friends, who were alongside the Douse Drive Genesect and the Pokémon residing in Pokémon Hills. During the fight, Mewtwo then discovers that the Red Genesect refuses to listen to such a reason and believes that the Genesect do not deserve to live in the modern world. After the fight throughout the city, the two then went back to Pokémon Hills, where the Red Genesect saves its teammates, who are defeated by the residing Pokémon, and then controls the Genesect Army to attack all of the opposing Pokémon. When they were about to deliver their final attack, Ash stepped into the way to protect them. Before being hit by the blast, the Douse Drive Genesect stepped into the way to protect Ash and took heavy damage. Thinking that the Douse Drive Genesect is dead, they attack their resident Pokémon in formation, who are then protected by Mewtwo. Afterwards, Mewtwo then took on the four Genesect alone. The fight between Mewtwo and the four Genesect continued, and the three normal-colored Genesect wrapped Mewtwo around a string web, who then managed to escape using Psystrike, sending the 3 down. The Red Genesect then continues its fight with Mewtwo without its team. As the battle between Mewtwo and the Red Genesect went underway, Ash stepped in to stop them and told Mewtwo that he promised to give the Genesect Army a home and that no Pokémon is unneeded in the end. The Red Genesect then was about to hit Ash with its Techno Blast, only to be protected by the Douse Drive Genesect, alongside the rest of the Genesect Army, who then realized their mistakes and the rest of the Pokémon residents. Feeling betrayed, the Red Genesect still did not care, refusing to listen to everyone's reasons. Seeing that the Red Genesect stubbornly refuses to listen to their reason, Mewtwo then took the Red Genesect all the way up into the atmosphere to finish it off. It blacks out after the two Pokémon fly so high that they both begin to freeze. A short time later, Mewtwo wakes up alongside the Red Genesect, still in the upper atmosphere. The Red Genesect is in awe of the planet, and Mewtwo explains that it is the planet where they were both born, that they both exist for a reason, and that on this planet, they are all friends. The aggression fades from the Red Genesect's eyes, and it accepts the hand extended by Mewtwo as an invitation to return to its home. However, as they fall back down, Mewtwo blacks out again. The Red Genesect grabs Mewtwo and uses its power to send a signal to the other Genesect to "return home". The Genesect Army got this signal and then helped both Mewtwo and the Red Genesect from falling, aided by Ash's Charizard, Iris' Dragonite, and the Pokémon residents of Pokémon Hills, who then created a huge sphere of water for the two to land. Ash then suggested where the Genesect Army can stay: Absentia Natural Park. The Red Genesect and the Genesect Army are later seen living peacefully in the natural park, building their nest.
